scientific_choices.choice: Algorithm 2 / section 3.5 routes uncertain complete images to DeepSolo; the proposed inventory signals are outside that paper.
Keep audited YOLO640+PARSeq and ViTAEv2-S/TextOCR DeepSolo words, native256 ignore masks, exact casefold multiset matching and 80/45 fitting/calibration split.

Four GT-blind inventory rules; CRAFT frozen general-purpose checkpoint; rectangle coverage and IoU .25 matching; maximum 3 suspect-region OCR probes selected before readings. Full independent OCR is a separate costly agreement control. No final-word edits.
Chapman capture-recapture is an uncalibrated count/risk heuristic. Correlated detections and false positives violate its classical assumptions; it is not a statistical completeness certificate.

Fit optional ridge/ExtraTrees branch-benefit regressors only on 80 TRAIN images, RGB-grouped 5-fold CV; choose family and scalar cuts using 45 VAL images. Primary untrained probe rule and 50% bypass declared before fresh TEST inference; report all arms.
Single RTX3090, FP32 sequential CRAFT/PARSeq, detector batch1, OCR batch32; no claim of qualification on historical 8GB GPU. Record state hashes, shape and CUDA peaks.

The paper accuracy protocol is unspecified; this local nonspatial word F1 cannot establish an official paper win. Repeatedly explored TEST and small reused TRAIN constrain generalization. Shared PARSeq weights correlate recognizer errors.
